mapper.select: SELECT id, pond_id, record_date, biomass_kg, fish_count, avg_weight_kg, created_at FROM biomass_record WHERE pond_id = #{pondId} ORDER BY record_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pond_daily_metric (pond_id, record_date, fish_count, avg_weight_kg, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{pondId}, #{recordDate}, #{fishCount}, #{avgWeightKg}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE fish_count = VALUES(fish_count), avg_weight_kg = VALUES(avg_weight_kg), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
